title: Harnesses
description: The conversations' harnesses as the sandbox gateway binds and releases them in their pools, from its metrics; and the turns alasio ran again as their harness instance was lost under them, and how long a turn took to its harness's first output, from alasio's. Main's, or a branch environment's, as Branch chooses.

list.name: branch
list.label: Branch
list.description: main, or a branch environment (alasio branch): its harness pools, in its own namespace, and its alasio's turns, whose telemetry is tagged alasio.branch. A branch is offered where its alasio ran a turn, or its harness pools bound or released one, in the time range.

panels.title: Binds
panels.description: Conversations' harnesses bound in the time range, of every harness pool of the environment's.

panels.title: Mean bind time
panels.description: How long a harness's bind took on average in the time range, from its bind asked to its host serving.

panels.title: Bindings lost
panels.description: Bindings let go of as their pod went while they were bound: lost, deleted by other than the sandbox gateway, or its host ended.

panels.title: Turns run again
panels.description: Turns alasio ran again, once, as their harness instance was lost under them.

panels.title: Bind time
panels.description: How long the sandbox gateway took to bind a conversation's harness, by its pool and how its pod came: warm, a free pod claimed at once; cold, waited for as its pool was scaled.

url_options.data:
select time_bucket(to_milliseconds(${__interval_ms}), TimeUnix) as time, Attributes['alasio.binder.pool'] || ', ' || Attributes['alasio.binder.start'] as bind, sum(added_sum) / sum(added_count) as seconds
from (
select TimeUnix, Attributes, Sum - coalesce(lag(Sum) over series, 0) as added_sum, Count::bigint - coalesce(lag(Count::bigint) over series, 0) as added_count
from otel.metrics_histogram where MetricName = 'alasio.binder.bind.duration' and ServiceName = 'alasio-sandbox-gateway' and Attributes['alasio.binder.pool'] like 'harness-%' and Attributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = if(${branch:sqlstring} = 'main', 'alasio', 'alasio-branch-' || ${branch:sqlstring}) and TimeUnix >= epoch_ms(${__from}) - interval 1 hour and TimeUnix < epoch_ms(${__to})
window series as (partition by ResourceAttributes, Attributes, StartTimeUnix order by TimeUnix)
) where TimeUnix >= epoch_ms(${__from}) and added_count > 0
group by all order by 1

panels.title: Binds by pool
panels.description: Conversations' harnesses bound, by pool: a session conversation's harness, or a folder conversation's on the machine.

url_options.data:
select time_bucket(to_milliseconds(${__interval_ms}), TimeUnix) as time, Attributes['alasio.binder.pool'] as pool, sum(added_count) as binds
from (
select TimeUnix, Attributes, Sum - coalesce(lag(Sum) over series, 0) as added_sum, Count::bigint - coalesce(lag(Count::bigint) over series, 0) as added_count
from otel.metrics_histogram where MetricName = 'alasio.binder.bind.duration' and ServiceName = 'alasio-sandbox-gateway' and Attributes['alasio.binder.pool'] like 'harness-%' and Attributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = if(${branch:sqlstring} = 'main', 'alasio', 'alasio-branch-' || ${branch:sqlstring}) and TimeUnix >= epoch_ms(${__from}) - interval 1 hour and TimeUnix < epoch_ms(${__to})
window series as (partition by ResourceAttributes, Attributes, StartTimeUnix order by TimeUnix)
) where TimeUnix >= epoch_ms(${__from}) and added_count > 0
group by all order by 1

panels.title: Bindings released
panels.description: Harnesses' bindings the sandbox gateway let go of, by why: idle, by its sweep once the conversation was quiet for its time; asked, by alasio; lost, deleted or broken, as their pod went while they were bound.

url_options.data:
select time_bucket(to_milliseconds(${__interval_ms}), TimeUnix) as time, Attributes['alasio.gateway.release.reason'] as reason, sum(added) as releases
from (
select TimeUnix, Attributes, Value - coalesce(lag(Value) over series, 0) as added
from otel.metrics_sum where MetricName = 'alasio.gateway.releases' and ServiceName = 'alasio-sandbox-gateway' and Attributes['alasio.binder.pool'] like 'harness-%' and Attributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = if(${branch:sqlstring} = 'main', 'alasio', 'alasio-branch-' || ${branch:sqlstring}) and TimeUnix >= epoch_ms(${__from}) - interval 1 hour and TimeUnix < epoch_ms(${__to})
window series as (partition by ResourceAttributes, Attributes, StartTimeUnix order by TimeUnix)
) where TimeUnix >= epoch_ms(${__from}) and added > 0
group by all order by 1

panels.title: Bindings lost by pool
panels.description: Bindings let go of as their pod went while they were bound, by pool: each takes the turn it ran with it, which alasio runs again.

url_options.data:
select time_bucket(to_milliseconds(${__interval_ms}), TimeUnix) as time, Attributes['alasio.binder.pool'] as pool, sum(added) as lost
from (
select TimeUnix, Attributes, Value - coalesce(lag(Value) over series, 0) as added
from otel.metrics_sum where MetricName = 'alasio.gateway.releases' and ServiceName = 'alasio-sandbox-gateway' and Attributes['alasio.binder.pool'] like 'harness-%' and Attributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = if(${branch:sqlstring} = 'main', 'alasio', 'alasio-branch-' || ${branch:sqlstring}) and Attributes['alasio.gateway.release.reason'] in ('lost', 'deleted', 'broken') and TimeUnix >= epoch_ms(${__from}) - interval 1 hour and TimeUnix < epoch_ms(${__to})
window series as (partition by ResourceAttributes, Attributes, StartTimeUnix order by TimeUnix)
) where TimeUnix >= epoch_ms(${__from}) and added > 0
group by all order by 1

panels.title: Lost turns
panels.description: Turns whose harness instance was lost under them, by how each came out: staged, run again; completed, its reply delivered as its pod finished it first; given-up, as one run again already was; and by what found it lost: its binding's loss, or alasio attaching to it again.

panels.title: First output
panels.description: How long a turn took to its harness's first output, by harness: its bind, its host's start and its harness's own included.
